detail.longDescription:
Get alerted the moment your server or website goes down.

Is My Server Online (IMSO) is a simple uptime monitor for your servers and websites. Add as many as you want, see their status at a glance, and receive a push or email notification as soon as something changes.

WEBSITE MONITORING
Check any website over HTTP or HTTPS. Validate the HTTP status code and the response content to make sure your site is not only reachable, but actually working.

SERVER MONITORING
Check any server by IP address or domain name, over TCP or UDP on a specific port, or with ping / ping6 with configurable TTL and packet size.

DOWNTIME ALERTS
Background checks run at the interval of your choice. Get notified by push notification or email on every check, or only when a status changes.

SSL & DOMAIN EXPIRY
See when your SSL certificate and domain name expire, and get a reminder before they do. Read the WHOIS summary of any domain.

HISTORY & STATISTICS
Each server has a detailed view with its uptime statistics, full status history and a network latency graph. When a check fails, a detailed error message explains why (timeout, connection refused, invalid code…).

FEATURES
- Live status: online, timeout, offline, error
- Uptime statistics and full status history
- Network latency graph
- Automatic background checks at a custom interval
- Push and email notifications
- SSL certificate and domain name expiry alerts
- WHOIS summary
- HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/UDP port and ping / ping6 checks
- Configurable timeout, connection attempts, valid HTTP codes and expected response content
- Check only on Wi-Fi or mobile data, or above a minimum signal quality
- Home screen widgets
- Dark and light mode

Made for sysadmins, developers, homelab enthusiasts and website owners who want to know their services are up, without a complex monitoring setup.
